input.limitation: Recovered fixture is a later state, exactly 24576 ticks after the requested input. New paired runs share this actual input; they do not reproduce the earlier interval.

threshold.reason: Prioritize 70.8% fewer local-policy constructions, 2.31% fewer waiting passengers, more initially present representatives delivered, better target-OD and traced CPU tails, and a 0.07% delivery difference; preserve the documented adverse fresh/censored sample metrics.
tradeoffs: 2048 has a lower ordinary fresh-completed sample mean (4309.74 vs4399.84 ticks).
2048 has lower right-censored pending-wait p95 (6736 vs7324) and p99 (15796 vs16990).
Target and ordinary representatives are unweighted samples with different fates, not paired causal population estimates.
The requested original input is missing; these paired runs use the identical later recovered save.

reverse_cpu_controls.note: Only the first 1024 ordinary ticks and their 513-1024 tail are accepted. One replacement tick is excluded from CPU claims.

flat_comparison.note: Separate processes include the identical frozen map/DB and one table each. Replay uses the persisted Work count with prime-size slices. OS peaks are process-wide; component counters describe completed table residency. Native JPSD and MP tests separately cover wire identities and mixed generations.

notes: Waiting/state/leftover totals count repeated departure opportunities, not distinct people.
State flags overlap; the five routing modes partition waiting units.
Available waiting and virtual reservations are reported separately; their combined total includes every local loading consist at station 3393.
other_intent includes valid bound reservations as well as older intent kinds; raw kind/current-intent fields distinguish them.
potential_loadable_after_cancel is a counterfactual bound using native legality immediately before leaving and space after reservation cancellation; it is not a later boarding opportunity.
live_prefix_legal tests a resolved ride with normalized readiness/age; can_board uses the actual packet.
live_prefix_legal=-1 means no concrete candidate ride; -2 means membership succeeded but no ride resolved. Neither is a native-prefix rejection.
free subtracts RemainingCount (kept cargo plus reservations); physical_free subtracts all physically stored cargo.
oldest_event_ticks=-1 means no existing event due time is available; the raw due tick is retained.
Leftover allocation follows the existing primary/sequence order; unindexed rows use packet ID as an explicit diagnostic proxy.
Order dispatches are actual UpdateOrderDest calls, including conditional attempts; PBS forecasts are excluded.
Expiry latencies cover observed expiry/replan pairs; pending units are right-censored at the measurement end.

final_boarding_profile.note: Nested enumeration/predicate/ride times overlap. Timers add observer overhead; this is attribution, not an uninstrumented CPU comparison.

sampling_limitations: Each run reports its sampling_method: ordinary runs use deterministic hash sampling of approximately one eligible packet in 64; independent focused runs select all packet representatives for the three target ODs. Each follows one person at the packet midpoint, capped at 65536 starts; neither is a population-weighted travel-time estimate. Do not pool focused and ordinary samples. Initial known-OD people are enrolled before settings change and matched by saved packet ID and offset. Loaded trips are left-censored; fresh full-trip and observed-origin-departure metrics are separate. Pending trips are right-censored; erasure/reduction without delivery is lost. All passenger movement totals use actual vehicle cargo, excluding reservations; population removals are the inventory residual, not a diagnosis of their cause. Service classes use actual vehicles' group names at movement; sampled service summaries use the end manifest. Observed misses cover only queried indexed candidates with positive free capacity, which other passengers may consume, and may undercount collective cache hits. Structural short turns conservatively require two reversal stops, a proper subset of a longer nominal route's stops and edges, and at least one internal reversal. Order count is not a service class. Physical distance is Manhattan displacement in 1/16-tile units.
